name: What preventative measures can I take to avoid stucco damage?

mainEntity.name: What preventative measures can I take to avoid stucco damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventative measures for stucco damage include regular inspections for cracks or signs of moisture, ensuring proper drainage around your home, and maintaining gutters and downspouts to direct water away from walls. Properly sealed windows and doors are crucial. Promptly addressing any small cracks or issues can prevent them from escalating. Periodic cleaning can also help identify potential problems early and preserve the stucco's integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent stucco damage by regular inspections, ensuring proper drainage, maintaining gutters, sealing windows, and addressing small cracks promptly.
